name: huit-agent-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for the AAIS group at Harvard University IT.

plugins.name: huit-github
plugins.description: GitHub integration for AAIS / HUIT without a Personal Access Token (github.com via remote MCP + OAuth, github.huit.harvard.edu via local MCP + gh login).

plugins.name: huit-aws
plugins.description: Log into HUIT AWS accounts from Claude Code: HarvardKey/Okta SAML via the HUIT aws-login CLI, or a refreshing aws login console-session attach. Skill /huit-aws:aws-login.

plugins.name: quiz
plugins.description: Short multiple-choice comprehension checks. /quiz:session asks about what happened in the current session (security-relevant changes, decisions made on your behalf, loose ends); /quiz:project asks about the gotchas of the repo you are in.
